name: Leguna Ashys
original_name: レグナー・アーシェス
source:
Wil's childhood friend and senior alchemist.
Always cool and collected while helping Wil.
He enjoys pushing himself as Wil's rival.

[spoiler]His real name is Krove Zilterry. He is [url=/c491]Emelita[/url]'s older brother and second surviving heir of the last Mikelty king.[/spoiler]
